column2: Add-ons are extra cars you install yourself. In game, each player takes one with F10, like the VAZ: with their colour and number, or with their own livery.
Installing a car
Character > Add-ons > Open the add-ons folder: the game's MWCoop\\addons folder opens.
Copy the car's folder (the one that contains addon.ini) into this folder.
Go back to the Add-ons tab: the car shows up there with its picture.

To turn an add-on off without deleting it, add a dot to its folder name (for example evo3.off). Everyone installs the add-ons they want to see: without the add-on, you see a VAZ of the same colour and number instead.
Taking it in game
F10 > Cars tab: pick the model (button or M key) and a free colour, then Take.
Colour and number are unique across all players, whatever the model.
Ice race and rally: you sign up with your players' car, VAZ or add-on.
Making your livery
Add-ons tab: click the car, then Template. A copy of the template opens in Explorer.
Paint over it in your software, keeping the size (2048 x 2048). The red hatched area gets your number: draw nothing important there.
My image…: choose your image. In use: yes / no goes back to the colour and number without losing the image; Remove deletes it.
In game, your livery is sent to the other players: everyone sees it.
